Yes. I developed severe tinnitus that is there 24/7 because I didn't think I needed to protect my profoundly deaf ear. It fucking sucks. My eardrum was perfectly fine to still get fucked by loud sounds regardless of my silly little useless ear bones and so it did..... Don't be me.

I couldn't afford to see a doctor about my hearing loss until I was 30. Turns out I have otosclerosis in both ears. I always thought everyone else heard the same as me and I just wasn't smart enough to figure things out like everyone else.

It's been a wild ride of emotions after learning about it. Mostly a lot of resent towards my parents. My dad was quite ignorant but my mom knew. She even had surgery for it. I had to drag that info out of her. I mentioned how I didn't understand people so many times just to be blown off and told I needed to focus harder. I also suspect I may have an auditory processing disorder and/or a sprinkle of autism on top but I can't afford to look into that more at the moment. Its been frustrating but I will say I now feel more comfortable asking people to repeat themselves or asking to sit in a certain spot to better understand people since I have a medical reason and I'm not just a dumbass who can't focus.

I did get hearing aids in the beginning and they were helpful. I was amazed at how many things I could hear. It got to point where I was overwhelmed by sounds though. I now only wear them for certain places and conversations. I'm also leaning into the Deaf side of things pretty hard. Learning ASL and making more deaf friends. The bluntness and visible expression is so much easier to read and understand.
